thread:
Rina: Quick design review: the preflight/network step should offer one-click remediation suggestions when checks fail. Customers keep seeing raw dumps and asking what to do next.

Noah: Agreed. Idea: show a "Next steps" mini-panel with 2-3 prescriptive actions (e.g., toggle firewall, verify DNS, open port) and a primary "Run quick diagnostic". If they open logs, show only a short summary + a Download .log link.

Eve: Accessibility notes: when a failure state appears, we should announce it with a live region and move keyboard focus to the first step in the mini-panel. Right now focus stays on the continue button which is confusing.

Design-bot: Proposed copy: Title: "Connectivity check" Body: "We couldn't reach your host. Try these quick steps: verify DNS, allow outbound to port 5678, and check your firewall." Primary CTA: "Run quick diagnostic" Secondary: "Open support ticket". Keep it snappy.

Noah: UX detail: include an inline checklist with collapsible items. Each expanded item shows a single command and a copy button (e.g., `nc -vz 10.10.0.5 5678`). Copy success should be announced via a polite live region.

Rina: Also add tiny remediation shortcuts where possible: e.g., if we detect a missing outbound route we can surface a one-click suggestion like "Enable recommended egress policy" that opens a step-by-step KB modal. But make it opt-in and auditable.

Eve: Modal vs inline: prefer a centered modal for diagnostics because it traps focus and is simpler for screenreader flow. The modal should show an overall pass/fail, short logs summary (single-line), and a download link for full logs. Do not render full raw logs in the main wizard frame.

Noah: Implementation: server should return a user-friendly failure code and short reason. UI maps codes to plain language (e.g., NET_TIMEOUT -> "Connection timed out: port may be blocked"). Provide an "Advanced details" disclosure that reveals more context but not the raw stack. Downloadable logs are presigned `.log`.

Design-bot: A11y implementation hints: error pill use `role=alert` and `aria-live=assertive`; after it appears run `primaryButton.focus()`; disclosure toggles must be real buttons with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Ensure tooltips are keyboard accessible and on mobile replace hover tooltips with inline chevrons.

infra-bot: Diagnostic service note: keep the downloadable logs truncated to 1MB and strip internal stack traces. Tag analytics events: `preflight.failure_shown`, `diagnostic.started`, `log.downloaded`, `support_ticket.created` with host/port hashed.

Rina: Visual polish: error icon color needs stronger contrast at small sizes. Also the mini-panel should have a subtle left border to separate it from the wizard flow.

Eve: UX question: should we persist the wizard state if the user opens diagnostics and then closes the modal? I think yes, restore focus to the same place and show a small toast "Diagnostic saved to session" announced politely.

Noah: Sounds good. I'll prototype the mini-panel and modal flow. Will include copy A/B variants for the port help: "allow outbound to 5678" vs "open on your firewall: 5678". We'll sample on new accounts.

Rina: Thanks — please include keyboard walkthroughs in the spec doc (tab order, focus restore, aria-describedby ids). Ping when mocks are ready for an accessibility pass. :sparkles:
